description: The conflict DefaultStrings.java:1570-1576 documents in prose: the JDK's IANA equivalence table maps nsl to sgn-NO while CLDR canonicalizes sgn-NO to nsi. Both nsl and nsi are loaded so the two data sources point at different, individually reachable sources; they do not share a canonical language code, so no tiebreakers are needed and the fixture builds. A port that took the transitive union of the two tables would collapse nsl and nsi into one preference and could not reproduce these rows.
